name: pg_semantius
abstract: Database-first RBAC, RLS, data dictionary, and message queue for PostgreSQL
description: Semantius core packaged as a PostgreSQL extension: role-based access control, row-level security, a semantic data dictionary, and a message queue. An alternative to deploying the migrations with the Semantius CLI.
